protocol.ingestion: 8 events per cycle, rotating -- identical to the live daemon
protocol.scoring: forward-looking: the last 10 cycles are scored against events the organism had not yet seen
protocol.note: single seed per condition; no variance estimate is claimed

not_measurable.cy: Q_resolved / Q_generated -- no experiment executor exists, so no Question is ever resolved; identically 0 for every condition
not_measurable.eig_star: H_before - H_after -- experiments are generated but never executed, so no belief entropy ever changes; identically 0
not_measurable.dpf: requires the human designer to record predictions before a run; cannot be automated without circularity
